Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosures for single burial use of multiple internment space.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to single burial use of multiple internment space;and adding a new section to chapter 68.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any cemetery authority offering single burial use of multipleinternment space, or any internment whereby a single burial use isoffered in a burial plot where multiple internments will be made, mustinclude the following, or a substantially similar disclosure printed onthe internment contract in regular sized font before the signaturelines: Single burial use of a multiple internment space means that morethan one casket may be buried in layers in the same burial plot.
